package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for domain_errors_declared_in_handler_package: Business error types declared only in handlers instead of a reusable domain or service boundary.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.

var ErrUserNotFound = errors.New("user not found")
var ErrInvalidOrder = errors.New("invalid order")
var ErrInsufficientBalance = errors.New("insufficient balance")

func GetUserHandler(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
	if id == "" {
		http.Error(w, ErrUserNotFound.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
		return
	}
	fmt.Fprint(w, "user found")
}
